sentences.text:
(Per the Hon'ble Sri Justice J.Sreenivas Rao) W.P.No.25305 of 2018 is filed for the following relief:
"...Issue a writ, order or direction more particularly in the nature of Mandamus by declaring the action of the respondents in not following the procedure laid down under sections 4, 11, 12, 21, 26 and 28 of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 in respect of the petitioners land in Sy.Nos.23/1, 23/1/2, 23/1/3, 23/1/4, 23/1/5 and 23/1/6 admeasuring Ac.1.05 guntas, Ac.1.05 guntas, Ac.1.05 guntas, Ac.1.05 guntas,
Ac.3.00 guntas and Ac.3.17 guntas respectively total admeasuring Ac.11.17 guntas situated at Naspur Village and Mandal of Mancherial District (Erstwhile Adilabad District) which were acquired for the purpose of construction of integrated Collectorate as illegal, arbitrary and contrary to law apart from violation of Articles 14, 19(i) (g), 21 and 300A of the Constitution of India and consequently direct the respondents to issue fresh notification in respect of the petitioners lands above mentioned."

W.P.No.23888 of 2019 is filed for the following relief:
"...Issue a writ, order or direction more particularly in the nature of Mandamus by declaring the action of the respondents in not following the procedure laid down under sections 4, 11, 12, 21, 26 and 28 of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and resettlement Act, 2013 in respect of the petitioners land in Sy.Nos.23/1/2, 23/1/3 and 23/1/4 admeasuring Ac.1.05 guntas, Ac.1.05 guntas and Ac.1.05 guntas respectively total admeasuring Ac.03.15 guntas situated at Naspur Village and Mandal of Mancherial District (Erstwhile Adilabad District) which were acquired for the purpose of construction of integrated Collectorate as illegal, arbitrary and contrary to law apart from violation of Articles 14, 19(i)(g), 21 and 300A of the Constitution of India and consequently direct the respondents to issue fresh notification in respect of the petitioners lands above mentioned."
2. Heard Sri C.Praveen, learned counsel representing Sri M.R.S.Srinivas, learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri S.Laxminarayana, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition Syed Bin Hasan vs The State Of Telangana on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71605966/
1 appearing on behalf of respondent No.4.
3.

sentences.text: 4. The record discloses that the petitioners have not questioned the above said award passed by respondent No.4 on 22.05.2018, in these writ petitions.
5. Hence, this Court is of the considered view that the cause in the writ petitions does not survive for adjudication.

6. Accordingly, these Writ Petitions are disposed of, granting liberty to the petitioners to avail the remedies as available under law, including questioning the award dated 22.05.2018 passed by respondent No.4.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, pending if any, shall stand closed.
